description: Enterprise. Finds contiguous same-owner land assemblies near a Texas address or coordinate that suit utility solar: total acres at or above a minimum, a minimum share of ground under 5 percent slope (USGS 3DEP), and a transmission line at or above a kV within a distance. Returns acres, flat acres, mean slope, parcel ids, nearest line kV and miles, distance from the search point, and oil and gas wells on the land (RRC, active and plugged). Owners are not named. Next step: site_screen, then a solar layout on the parcel ids.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

line_kv_min.description: Minimum transmission voltage in kV. Default 138.

line_within_mi.description: Line must be within this many miles. Default 2.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

min_acres.description: Minimum assembly size in acres. Default 800 (about 50 to 60 MW-ac).

min_flat_pct.description: Minimum percent of the land under 5 percent slope. Default 80.

radius_mi.description: Search radius in miles, 1 to 60. Default 30.

name: solar_find
title: Find solar-ready land near a point
